registered.message: Course code (I) is empty.
registered.fix: Enter the course code

registered.message: Course title (II) is empty.
registered.fix: Enter the course title

registered.message: Program is empty.
registered.fix: Choose the program

registered.message: Course description (III) is empty.
registered.fix: Write the course description

registered.message: Pre-requisite (IV) is empty.
registered.fix: Enter the pre-requisite

registered.message: Lecture and laboratory units (V) are not both entered.
registered.fix: Enter the lecture and laboratory units

registered.message: There are no course learning outcomes (VI).
registered.fix: Ask an administrator to add the course learning outcomes

registered.message: The Learning Plan (VII) has no lesson with a learning outcome (ILO).
registered.fix: Add a lesson with a learning outcome (ILO)

registered.message: The vision in this syllabus is not the school's current vision.
registered.fix: Resubmit so the syllabus carries the current vision
registered.note: A draft has no stored copy (it always shows the live text) and a submit stores the live text, so this fails only if the stored snapshot differs from the live catalog, for example when an admin edited it after the syllabus was submitted.

registered.message: The mission in this syllabus is not the school's current mission.
registered.fix: Resubmit so the syllabus carries the current mission

registered.message: The graduate attributes (EGAs) in this syllabus are not the program's current ones.
registered.fix: Resubmit so the syllabus carries the current graduate attributes

registered.message: The program outcomes (POs) in this syllabus are not the program's current ones.
registered.fix: Resubmit so the syllabus carries the current program outcomes

registered.message: {where} has no CLO tag.
registered.fix: Tag every ILO with the CLO it builds

registered.message: {where} has a tag that no longer resolves: {tag}.
registered.fix: Fix the outcome tags that no longer resolve

registered.message: Learning Plan row {row} is missing the column: {missing}.
registered.fix: Complete the Learning Plan columns

registered.message: {where} has nothing in: {missing}.
registered.fix: Fill in the empty Learning Plan columns
registered.note: The builder only advises about empty columns, so this is major, not blocking.

registered.message: {where} has an empty ILO before a filled one, so the printed numbering has a gap.
registered.fix: Remove the empty ILO between filled ones
registered.note: ILO numbers are generated by position (ILO1, ILO2, ...), so the only way to break the numbering is an empty ILO between filled ones.

registered.message: Learning Plan row {row} comes before an earlier week.
registered.fix: Put the Learning Plan rows in week order
registered.note: Added: rows printed out of week order. The builder allows any order.

registered.message: Course requirements (VIII): {have} listed, at least {need} needed.
registered.fix: List at least three course requirements

registered.message: Requirement "{text}" starts with its own number; the form numbers the list for you.
registered.fix: Remove the typed numbers from the requirements

registered.message: References ({letter}. {title}) has no entries and is not marked not applicable.
registered.fix: Fill in each reference group or mark it not applicable

registered.message: References ({letter}. {title}) is marked not applicable but has entries.
registered.fix: Resolve the reference group marked not applicable that has entries

registered.message: The Grading System (X) has no components.
registered.fix: Add the grading components

registered.message: The grading components total {total}%, not {need}%.
registered.fix: Make the grading components total 100%

registered.message: The override formulas cannot be empty.
registered.fix: Fill in the override formulas or switch them off

registered.message: The {which} formula does not mention {missing}.
registered.fix: Make the grading formulas name every component and exam term
registered.note: The Term Grade formula must list every grading component with its percentage; the Final Rating formula must name every examination term.

registered.message: The sign-off block is not as the form requires: {problem}.
registered.fix: Check the sign-off block
registered.note: UNSURE. The preparer comes from the owner's account and the other two roles are added by the system, so this can only fail when the stored sign-off holds names a faculty member should not enter.

registered.message: The course description is {words} {nouns}; about {need} are expected.
registered.fix: Expand the course description

registered.message: {where} is only {words} {nouns}; an ILO states what the student will do.
registered.fix: Write fuller learning outcomes (ILOs)

registered.message: CLO {n} has no {missing}.
registered.fix: Ask an administrator to complete the CLO titles and statements

registered.message: There are {have} references; at least {need} are expected.
registered.fix: Add more references

registered.message: CLO {n} is not tagged with a valid graduate attribute (EGA).
registered.fix: Ask an administrator to tag each CLO with graduate attributes
registered.note: Admin-managed data; the builder already holds faculty at step 2 for this.

registered.message: CLO {n} is not tagged with a valid program outcome (PO).
registered.fix: Ask an administrator to tag each CLO with program outcomes
registered.note: Admin-managed data; the builder already holds faculty at step 2 for this.

registered.message: CLO {n} is tagged PO {po}, which maps to EGA {ega}, but EGA {ega} is not tagged.
registered.fix: Ask an administrator to tag the EGAs the POs imply

registered.message: CLO {n}'s tags would not print as {format}: numbers must be unique and in order.
registered.fix: Ask an administrator to put the CLO tags in order

registered.message: CLO {n} is not built by any ILO in the Learning Plan.
registered.fix: Cover every course outcome in the Learning Plan

registered.message: {where} has no assessment task.
registered.fix: Add an assessment task to every lesson

registered.message: CLO {n} is not assessed: no week that builds it has an assessment task.
registered.fix: Assess every course learning outcome

registered.message: There is no {term} examination row in the Learning Plan.
registered.fix: Add the missing examination rows

registered.message: The grading system has no examination component.
registered.fix: Include an examination in the grading system

registered.message: The credit units are not usable: lecture {lecture}, laboratory {lab}.
registered.fix: Correct the credit units

registered.message: The plan covers {planned} of {expected} weeks{hours}.
registered.fix: Plan the full term

registered.message: Row {row} has a week that is not within 1 to {to}: "{week}".
registered.fix: Fix the weeks outside the term

registered.message: Week{s} {weeks} appear{verb} in more than one row.
registered.fix: Resolve the weeks used by more than one row

registered.message: There are no references.
registered.fix: Add references

registered.message: A reference has no year: "{text}".
registered.fix: Add the year to each reference

registered.message: A reference is {age} years old ({year}); the limit is {limit}: "{text}".
registered.fix: Replace the outdated references
registered.note: Age is measured from the school year the syllabus belongs to, never from today's date.
